payload.entry: Epic sase-1jc authorizes retiring agents_unified_query (all 23 flags resolved enabled; user requested clean slate superseding dossier wait dates). Phase sase-1jc.6 removed the registry definition, made the Rust agents-live profile and FilterBar unconditional, deleted the legacy agent_query parser/evaluator/pushdown, QueryEditModal and Off branches after tracing every consumer, and kept saved-query legacy-dialect warning compatibility, history scoping via live keys, Rust pushdown, and async refresh. Verified: just fmt clean; focused suites green (query persistence, unified filter, pushdown, loader window, finalize plan/fleet, seed, machines, node jump/finder, refresh paths, kill/dismiss, completion, filter-bar, tiering oracle, timezone, macro directives, query conformance).
